question: As of 2026-11-24, does the car brand Fisker (Fisker Inc., or any company now selling Fisker-branded vehicles) sell new cars to consumers in the United States?

sources.title: Fisker bankruptcy plan approved after deal on vehicle tech support
Operating Report Filed Pursuant to Section 4.14 of the Liquidating Trust Agreement for the Period from July 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026

finding: Reuters reports that Fisker liquidated its operations and sold its remaining vehicle fleet to American Lease, while a November 17, 2026 court filing confirms continued administration by the Fisker Liquidating Trust. These sources support a finding of no new-car consumer sales by Fisker in the United States as of November 24, 2026; no dated source found establishes that a successor has resumed Fisker-branded new-car sales.
